assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: transparent first-person hand and flashlight overlay for a photorealistic Korean horror game.
Create one 1024x1024 square PNG with genuine transparent alpha.
Subject: an adult Korean man's anatomically natural RIGHT hand and forearm firmly gripping a short, worn, unbranded black flashlight. View is from the player's own eyes, looking down the flashlight barrel as it points forward into depth and slightly toward the upper-left. The back/side of the right hand is visible; five fingers with natural wrapped grip, distinct believable knuckles, fingernails, fine arm hairs, small skin creases and real pores. Dark rolled cotton sleeve near the elbow.
Composition: only the forearm, hand, and flashlight appear. Forearm enters and is cropped at the lower-right border, hand sits in the middle-right, flashlight projects toward center/upper-left. Generous transparent negative space around the silhouette, especially top and left. This is a realistic first-person viewmodel film-prop photograph, not a product held up facing the viewer.
Lighting: soft neutral slightly cool diffuse illumination, realistic detailed skin, worn matte black flashlight.
Constraints: flashlight is UNLIT, no beam or glow. NO background whatsoever: all empty pixels are actually transparent alpha, not black, not white, not a rendered checkerboard. No floor, no shadows outside the isolated subject, no extra arms or fingers, no mannequin/plastic skin, no text or logos.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: material texture atlas for a Korean horror game.
Create one 2048x2048 square texture image, precisely divided into exactly 2x2 equal square quadrants with no gutters, borders, labels, blending or overlap between materials. Each quadrant must read as a flat high-detail texture scan, orthographic view, with even neutral albedo illumination and tileable edges within that quadrant.
Top-left quadrant: decaying 1990s Korean apartment pale ivory wall plaster with damp mineral stains, patches of peeling paint, realistic fine roughness and layers of age.
Top-right quadrant: worn small grey/beige ceramic floor tiles, regular square tile grid, grimy grout and subtle surface wear.
Bottom-left quadrant: old grey parking garage concrete, tiny fine cracks, pores, subtle water stains and mottled weathering.
Bottom-right quadrant: rusted brushed elevator steel, fine vertical brushing, irregular rust speckles and worn metallic grey.
Constraints: exactly these FOUR materials in this location order. Flat scans, NO perspective, no wall corners, no objects, no fixtures, no text, no dramatic shadows, no directional light or baked highlights. No transparent areas. Practical photorealistic material scans, not an illustration.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: transparent driver cockpit overlay for a first-person Korean horror driving game, placed over a live 3D road scene.
Create one 1536x1024 landscape PNG with genuine transparent alpha.
Subject: the worn interior dashboard of an unbranded 1990s Korean LEFT-HAND DRIVE sedan. Black textured steering wheel on the left side of the cockpit, analogue speedometer and tachometer instrument gauges, period-correct dark faded plastic dashboard, subtle leather/rubber wear. Two anatomically natural adult Korean male hands grip the steering wheel at approximately 9 and 3 o'clock, wrists and partial forearms in dark cotton sleeves. Realistic skin pores, fingernails, wrinkles and knuckles, natural grip and believable proportions.
Camera: first-person driver-eye view, very slightly offset to the right of the steering wheel while still sitting in the left driver's seat. Cockpit shows perspective depth, broad dashboard spreading toward passenger side on the right.
Composition is critical: the entire dashboard, steering wheel, hands and sleeves occupy ONLY the bottom half of the image, clipped naturally by the lower and side edges. The TOP HALF must be completely transparent alpha so a moving 3D road can be composited there through the absent windshield. Preserve genuine transparency in every empty area above the dashboard silhouette. No scenery or painted background, no visible windshield glass, no car roof, NO A-pillars, no mirrors, no headlight beams. Do not fill empty space black or white and do not draw a checkerboard.
Lighting: dim neutral cool practical illumination, enough detail to see plastic grain, worn leather and natural skin, subtly readable analogue gauges, no dramatic colored lights.
Style: convincing physical film-prop cockpit photography with realistic materials and hands; no illustration, no stylized game graphics, no brand logos, no added text.
